text:
leah: FYI — onboarding sample deployed to Cloudflare Workers is failing with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED when importing the SDK from the package root. Repro below. :grimacing:

omar: saw a support ticket too. Can you paste the import line + package.json?

leah: import in worker:
```js
import { RedwoodClient } from 'redwood-inference';
const r = new RedwoodClient({ key: __ENV.REDWOOD_KEY });
await r.generate('hello');
```
error: ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED: Package subpath './lib/index.js' is not defined by "exports"
package.json snippet:
```json
{"name":"redwood-inference","version":"2.0.0","exports":{"./lib/index.js":"./lib/index.cjs"},"main":"lib/index.cjs","types":"lib/index.d.ts"}
```

kai: root cause: the exports map only exposes the CJS file. Edge runtimes / bundlers prefer ESM import conditions (strict ESM), so resolving the package root or expecting an import entry fails. TS/IDEs also get confused when exports exists but types aren't exported.

nat: quick fix pattern we've used: add import + require + types to the root entry and expose package.json if bundlers read it. Example that fixed a similar issue: 
```json
{"exports":{".":{"import":"./lib/index.mjs","require":"./lib/index.cjs","types":"./lib/index.d.ts"},"./package.json":"./package.json"},"types":"lib/index.d.ts"}
```

omar: alternatively ship a tiny ESM entry that re-exports the CJS implementation (or build proper ESM). Also ensure you include the types export because TS server sometimes ignores top-level "types" when exports is present.

leah: customers also report no editor completions; will adding top-level "types" always fix that? some editors still fail even after top-level types.

kai: top-level helps for the package root, but when tooling resolves via exports, you should include a types path on the export subpath. Behavior varies across node versions, tsserver, bundlers, and edge platforms.

nat: recommended action items: 
- revert the export-map-only-CJS change and cut a patch that exposes import+require+types on the root (P0)
- add a small CI matrix job that runs our sample apps in Vercel Edge emulator and Cloudflare Pages preview for PRs touching packaging (P1)
- docs: short note on export maps + edge runtimes + TS quirks (P2)

ci-bot: PR opened: revert-exportmap-change (#3128) with additional small test matrix. CI passes on Node 18/20 and in our bundler smoke.

leah: short-term workaround to give to customers: pin to previous patch or import explicit ESM path: `import { RedwoodClient } from 'redwood-inference/lib/index.mjs'` until we ship the patch. Not ideal but unblockz.

omar: I'll coordinate the patch release and add the changelog blurb.

leah: adding the support repros to the issue and will keep the thread updated. Thanks! :thumbsup:
